Daniel B. Mason (Cooper) is a molecular/ wastewater epidemiologist and data scientist with over 5 years' experience in public health research and applied analytics. He holds a MPH in Epidemiology from the University of Kentucky, and his work focuses on wastewater-based surveillance for infectious diseases, environmental health, and data-driven public health decision-making. He has published in peer-reviewed journals and presented at conferences on topics including population health and electronic medical record based analysis. 

## TidyTuesday 2026 | Weekly Data Analysis & Visualization

Weekly data analyses and visualizations for the [#TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday) social data project, hosted by the R4DS Community.

Each week a new dataset is released. This site collects my explorations for 2026, built with R and Quarto.

### Tech Stack

- **Language**: R
- **Visualization**: ggplot2
- **Data Wrangling**: dplyr, tidyr
- **Reporting**: Quarto
- **Reproducibility**: per-week `renv` lockfiles
